newsitem.title: UK: BG shares dip after asset writedown report.
newsitem.headline: BG shares dip after asset writedown report.

text.p: Shares in BG Plc, the former British Gas group which spun off its distribution arm Centrica Plc, dipped early on Wednesday after a report that it faces a huge asset writedown.
The stock was down 2p at 171-1/2 by 0806 GMT.
A report in the Times newspaper said the Monopolies and Merger Commission was likely to adopt a valuation of BG's assets made by Ofgas, the industry regulator.

This would value BG's assets at 12.5 billion stg compared with 18 billion in BG's latest accounts. The issue is important because the valuation affects the return which BG is allowed to earn on its assets.
BG is in dispute with Ofgas and is awaiting the results of a regulatory review which is in the hands of the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
No-one at BG was immediately availble for comment.
